description: One append-only state change of a phase revision, on either the simulation or the governance trace.

decision_ref.description: Acceptance decision id. Required on the governance trace for 'executing' and 'accepted'; forbidden on the simulation trace.
decision_ref.title: Decision Ref

evidence_refs.description: Reading ids the transition relied on.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

idempotency_key.description: Replay key. Same key and input digest is a no-op; a changed input is a conflict.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

prior_state.description: State before the event; None only for the creating event.
prior_state.title: Prior State

sequence.description: Position in the revision's event chain; 0 only for the creating event.
sequence.title: Sequence

trace.description: simulation records synthetic dynamics and can never carry authority; governance records the human decision chain. They are distinct traces.
trace.title: Trace

transition_policy_version.description: Version of the transition rules applied.
transition_policy_version.title: Transition Policy Version

title: PhaseTransitionEvent
